svg.text: SELECT id, name, cached_balance, currency FROM wallets WHERE id = 10 AND user_id = ?
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type='DEBIT' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) AS ledger_sum FROM ledger_entries WHERE wallet_id = 10
INSERT INTO security_audit_logs (user_id, event, created_at) VALUES (?, 'LEDGER_MISMATCH', NOW())
200 OK { status: 'MISMATCHED', cachedBalance, ledgerSum, delta, warning: 'Lệch số dư sổ cái!' }

SELECT ft.occurred_on, ft.transaction_type, c.name AS category_name, w.name AS wallet_name, ft.amount, ft.currency, ft.description, ft.note FROM financial_transactions ft JOIN wallets w ON ft.wallet_id = w.id LEFT JOIN transaction_categories c ON ft.category_id = c.id WHERE ft.user_id = ? AND ft.occurred_on BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' AND ft.wallet_id = 10 ORDER BY ft.occurred_on DESC
INSERT INTO export_audit_logs (user_id, export_type, row_count, file_hash, ip_address, created_at) VALUES (?, 'TRANSACTION_CSV', 50, ?, '192.168.1.15', NOW())
200 OK (Tải tệp CSV an toàn - Content-Type: text/csv)
